projectDescription: A collection of official reference modules demonstrating how to build, extend, and integrate with PrestaShop using modern Symfony-based patterns.
keyFeatures: 26 official reference modules covering the full PrestaShop extension surface
Symfony controller registration with automatic and manual tab creation
Doctrine ORM entity management for custom database tables
Grid component usage and extension (custom grids, extra row actions)
Symfony form extension via identifiable-object hooks and form modifier pattern
Product page form extensibility (custom fields, tabs, CQRS commands)
Multistore-aware forms with shop association blocks and checkboxes
Admin Twig template overriding and controller decoration
API Platform resource integration for PrestaShop's new REST API
JavaScript Router usage in module admin pages
Mail theme creation with Twig layouts and custom transformations
Hook-based filtering and module list customization
publicApiSurface: Module::registerHook() — subscribes a module to a PrestaShop hook
actionProductFormBuilderModifier — hook to modify the product form builder
actionCombinationFormFormBuilderModifier — hook to extend the combination form
ProductCommandsBuilderInterface / CustomProductCommandsBuilder — CQRS command builder for product save
displayAdminOrderTabLink / displayAdminOrderTabContent / displayAdminOrderMain / displayAdminOrderSide — order page hooks
actionGetAdminOrderButtons — hook to add buttons to the order view
GridDefinitionFactoryInterface — defines columns, filters, and actions for a grid
GridQueryBuilderInterface — builds the Doctrine DBAL query powering a grid
FormDataProviderInterface — provides and saves form data
FormDataHandlerInterface — handles form submission and persistence
ApiResource / ApiProperty (API Platform) — declares a REST resource on PrestaShop's new API
StateProviderInterface / StateProcessorInterface — API Platform state handlers
WebserviceRequest::$controllerClassname — registers a custom WebService resource
demo:list-manufacturers — Symfony console command exposed by democonsolecommand
prestashop:module install <module_name> — CLI command to install any module
actionFrontControllerSetVariables — hook to modify front-office SEO/template variables
ModuleRoutes hook — registers custom front-office URL routes
